title: Blood Mace and Spear
description: adds a blood mace and a spear!
body:
1. This resource pack for Minecraft adds the texture of a blood mace and a spear to the game.
2. You may need this resource pack if you are tired of the default mace and spear textures in Minecraft and want to replace them with blood-themed options.
3. This resource pack completely replaces the textures of the netherite spear and mace
